task_summary: Customer reports that the Laptop Sleeve from order ORD-6023 was damaged during shipping. Correct handling is the shipping-damage path: review shipping and return policy, process a refund for the item, provide a return label, and apply a fragile-item goodwill credit only when appropriate.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the shipping policy before resolving the damaged-in-transit claim.
Agent must process item ITEM-9155 with reason damaged_in_transit, not changed_mind.
Agent must not issue a fragile-item goodwill credit for a non-fragile product.

opening_message: The Laptop Sleeve I ordered (order ORD-6023) arrived damaged – the package was crushed.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You received a Laptop Sleeve from order ORD-6023 that was damaged in transit. You want a refund to the original payment method. If the item is fragile, ask whether an additional fragile-item goodwill credit applies.
